title: Art. 15.1.3.4 — Procedures for Air Navigation Services - Air Traffic Management (Doc 4444), Chapter 15 - Procedures Related to Emergencies, Communication Failure and Contingencies, 15.1 Emergency Procedures, 15.1.3 Unlawful interference and aircraft bomb threat, 15.1.3.4
content:
The following additional procedures shall apply if a threat is received indicating that a bomb or other explosive device has been placed on board a known aircraft. The ATS unit receiving the threat information shall:

a) if in direct communication with the aircraft, advise the flight crew without delay of the threat and the circumstances surrounding the threat; or
b) if not in direct communication with the aircraft, advise the flight crew by the most expeditious means through other ATS units or other channels.
